title: Billing and Coding: Diagnostic  Abdominal Aortography and Renal Angiography

codes.1: Angiography of the arteries in the Abdomen, Pelvis, or Lower Extremity branches. Aortography of the arteries in the Abdomen with or without the Lower Extremity arteries. Note : Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT/HCPCS codes in their CPT/HCPCS book. The following CPT code associated with the services outlined in this Billing and Coding Article will not have diagnosis limitations applied at this time: 36200.
codes.3: Aortography with or without Angiography of the arteries in the Abdomen and the Lower Extremities .

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT Codes: 36245, 36246, 36247, 36248, 75625, and 75726.
